### vendor-signup-390 (390px)
- **Top banner arrow missing**: The green promotional banner in the design ends with a right-pointing arrow/chevron (▶); the preview omits this icon.
- **Form subtitle copy incorrect**: The design subtitle under "Vendor Registration" reads "Register with Peptrace to build client trust."; the preview incorrectly renders the desktop copy "Register your business with Peptrace and build customer trust." at mobile width.
- **Terms checkbox asterisk spacing**: The design renders the required asterisk with a preceding space ("Partner Service Terms *"); the preview attaches it directly to the word ("Partner Service Terms*").
- **Footer link vertical spacing**: The vertical gaps between stacked footer navigation links in the preview are noticeably tighter than in the design; the design expects more generous `margin-bottom` or `line-height` between items.
- **Footer section vertical spacing**: The margin between consecutive footer sections on mobile (e.g., from the last "Explore" link to the "Testing" heading) is smaller in the preview than in the design.

### vendor-signup-1440 (1440px)
- **Missing icon in Premium upgrade panel**: The design displays a small sparkle/star icon to the left of the "Upgrade to Premium for 10% off on Launch with Peptrace" text inside the premium panel; the preview lacks this icon, causing the text to sit farther left.
- **Footer visual match**: The three-column footer layout, link typography, column headers, and copyright placement visually match the design; no discrepancies detected.

*(Note: iPad-VendorSignUp (744px) image pair was not provided; comparison skipped.)*
